job.title: Head of Customer Success

You’ll lead the redesign of the CS operating model, building playbooks, processes and frameworks that improve retention, expansion and customer engagement. Working closely with a team of Customer Success Managers, you’ll create a scalable function that supports the next phase of growth while driving meaningful change across the business.

Location: Melbourne or Perth (Hybrid – 3 days in the office) Salary: $165,000 – $170,000 Base + Super + Performance Incentive Sector: EdTech / SaaS

  • Own Customer Success Strategy: Take full ownership of Customer Success across ANZ, driving retention, customer growth and improved commercial outcomes across a large customer base.

  • Lead & Develop the Team: Coach and empower a team of 7 Customer Success Managers across VIC, Sydney and Perth, lifting capability, accountability and customer engagement.
  • Drive Commercial Growth: Own Net Revenue Retention (NRR), partnering closely with Sales to identify expansion opportunities and improve customer lifetime value.
  • Build a Data-Led Approach: Introduce customer health scoring, churn prediction and insights-driven decision-making to create a more proactive customer experience.

🎯 About You:
  • Experienced Customer Success Leader: You’ve successfully led Customer Success teams within SaaS, EdTech, or similar customer-focused technology environments.
  • Commercially Minded: You understand that great Customer Success goes beyond relationships; you’ve owned retention, expansion, and revenue outcomes.
  • A Builder & Transformer: You enjoy creating structure, improving processes and developing scalable ways of working in evolving environments.
  • Hands-On People Leader: You’re a player-coach who enjoys mentoring teams while remaining close to customers and their challenges.
  • Customer-First & Collaborative: You’re a low-ego leader who builds strong relationships, develops people, and creates a culture of shared success.

🙌🏻 The Perks:
  • Shape the Future of CS: Lead the evolution of an established Customer Success function and define how the team operates moving forward.
  • Meaningful Customer Impact: Support thousands of schools and educators by helping them get more value from innovative technology solutions.
  • Leadership & Autonomy: Have genuine ownership over strategy, processes and team development across ANZ.
  • Global SaaS Exposure: Join an international technology business with a strong market presence and ambitious growth plans.

job.title: SEO Strategist
job.description:
SEO Strategist | Up to $120K + Super

A fast-growing, full-service marketing agency based in Sydney is looking for an SEO Strategist to join their team. This is a strategy-first role, not a hands-on-keyboard technical grind.

The team is lean and tight-knit, eight people in the Sydney office plus an offshore team, with direct access to leadership. Recurring revenue is up 25% in the last three months alone, and the agency is still growing fast.

You'll own the strategic direction and client relationship across a portfolio of mid-sized and global B2B and B2C brands, covering technical, on-page, and off-page strategy. The agency leans heavily into AI, with a proprietary SEO growth engine that plugs into client websites and Google Search Console, analyses keyword and content opportunities, and generates content and landing pages at scale. You'll be directing that output and shaping the strategy behind it, backed by a dedicated AI team and content team.

Why This Job

Most SEO Strategist roles at this level still have you buried in audits and content briefs. Here, an AI team and content team handle that grunt work, so you're focused on strategy, client relationships, and growth, not execution. It's a small team with direct access to leadership, a portfolio spanning mid-sized and global brands, and an agency growing recurring revenue at 25% in the last quarter alone. Genuine ground floor, with room to shape how SEO is delivered.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own SEO strategy and the client relationship across a portfolio of mid-sized and global B2B and B2C clients
  • Set the strategic direction for technical, on-page, and off-page SEO, backed by AI tooling and a dedicated AI team
  • Translate performance data into insights and recommendations tied to real business objectives
  • Run reporting sessions and strategic reviews directly with clients

What They're Looking For

  • Minimum 4 years' hands-on SEO experience, agency-side preferred
  • Strong technical SEO knowledge: crawlability, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, schema
  • Confident with tools like Search Console, Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, Looker Studio
  • A strategic mindset, comfortable directing AI-driven SEO output rather than doing all the manual execution yourself
